evidence.quote: PBMCs were cryopreserved or lysed and stored at -80C for subsequent RNA extraction using miRNeasy (Qiagen) and hybridization to HG 1.0 ST arrays (Affymetrix).

For the present study, assays included antibody-forming cell responses, influenza-specific serum neutralization titers, multiple 15-color flow cytometric analyses (examining 126 cell subpopulations), and transcriptome analyses using microarrays
Virus-neutralizing titers (A/California/07/2009 (H1N1pdm09), H1N1 A/Brisbane/59/07, H3N2 A/Uruguay/716/07, and B/Brisbane/60/2001) were determined according to ( Hancock et al., 2009 ).
Total and influenza-specific IgG/A frequencies of antibody-secreting cells were measured by ELISpot assays modified for frozen samples ( Ho et al., 2011 ).
